entities.name: Archelos
entities.description: An ancient turtlefolk shaman from Bloomburrow who communes with the marshlands.

entities.name: Kwain
entities.description: A meddlesome rabbitfolk who alone can shrug off Archelos's slow magic.

relations.note: Archelos finds Kwain's disruptions vexing, but knows he will outlast him.
relations.quote: Archelos finds Kwain's constant disruptions vexing
